svg.aria-label: What's in the box. In the box, one way to stop for a person: waitForUser with a kind, approval, review or input, and a deadline only where the call or the host sets one; a task held on questions, asked at filing or midway, each answer a steer, the last picking the work up from its brief; the task's person mark and one list of holds on its row, a suspension or questions, shown by getTask and listTasks; a stop that ends once, answered, deadline or cancelled; one Inbox listing every stop; durable execution by default on file-backed hosts. Composed in by the app: what a block does at its deadline, which kind it asks, and the Inbox screen. Replaced in one line: parkOnQuestion and answerTask become the hold and a steer; awaitReview and unparkAndDrain become waitForUser review; the harness question inbox and answerQuestion become the hold and a steer into the same coding session. Not built, below a fence: telling the filer by message, FIX-2070; the renames, FIX-2071; replay across a deploy; serverless hosts without durability; an Inbox redesign; a hold released by an event, and ctx.waitForEvent.
